summary: Interac auto-confirm (Microsoft Graph) activation verification after user set INTERAC_AUTOCONFIRM_MODE=strict + 3 Azure AD creds. Restarted backend so new .env is loaded. Verified: (1) startup no longer logs 'disabled by configuration' — mode=strict is live; (2) all 3 creds are loaded into runtime (not empty); (3) watchdog task _interac_deposit_watchdog is scheduled at startup (line 9428-9429) and DID run (its error was observed in logs); (4) added new admin diagnostic endpoint GET /api/admin/interac/graph-health which performs a live token acquisition + /users/{user}/messages?$top=1 call — returned ok:true, http_status:200, latency_ms:800, messages_returned:1. Graph auth works, mailbox is reachable, Mail.Read admin consent IS granted. HOWEVER a BLOCKER remains: INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER is not configured in .env — so _process_interac_deposit_emails bails out at line 8129-8131 with 'Interac auto-confirm disabled: INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER is not configured' every poll cycle. Auto-confirm will NOT actually confirm any order until this env var is set (typically notify@payments.interac.ca). E2E regression: ran sprint4/5/6a — 26 pass, 14 fail, 6 skip — but ALL 14 failures are pre-existing Google Places address-validation 422s on hard-coded test addresses ('123 Rue Sprint #4' etc.), unrelated to the Interac config change. Sprint5 affiliate tests (the ones actually gated by iteration 28) all pass.

critical.issue: INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER is not set in backend/.env, so the poll loop authenticates to Graph successfully but returns immediately without processing any messages (server.py line 8129). Every 120s the log shows: 'ERROR - Interac auto-confirm disabled: INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER is not configured'. Interac auto-confirm is effectively still OFF at the business-logic level even though mode=strict. FIX: add INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER="notify@payments.interac.ca" (or the exact From address Interac uses for e-Transfer deposit notifications to the mailbox) to /app/backend/.env, then restart backend.

minor.issue: APP_ENV is not set — /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json publicly exposed. Warning present but not blocking. Should be APP_ENV=production before go-live.

graph_health_result.interpretation: Token acquisition against login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token succeeded (no 401 → creds are valid). GET /users/orders@fironova.com/messages?$top=1 returned 200 (no 403 → Mail.Read application permission has admin consent granted). The Graph plumbing is fully wired end-to-end.

action_items: CRITICAL: add INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER="notify@payments.interac.ca" (confirm exact From address by inspecting a real Interac deposit notification in orders@fironova.com; may also be catch@payments.interac.ca or similar) to /app/backend/.env and restart backend. Address-validation 422 failures in sprint4/sprint6a tests (14 of them) — hard-coded 'Rue Sprint #4' addresses are rejected by Google Places validator. Not related to this iteration but should be re-based to a validated address (e.g. use the suggestion returned by the API) — pre-existing issue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 14k+ lines — please split into routers/services modules (violates 700-line guideline). The new /admin/interac/graph-health handler I added is intentionally minimal (~70 lines) and self-contained.

_process_interac_deposit_emails logs an ERROR every poll cycle when INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER is missing. Recommend: (a) log a WARNING once at startup + downgrade the recurring line to DEBUG, OR (b) skip scheduling the watchdog when TRUSTED_SENDER is empty (same gate as the 3 Azure creds). Current behavior spams backend.err.log every 120s.

_graph_access_token uses r.raise_for_status() but the caller (_process_interac_deposit_emails) has no distinction between 4xx (auth error — actionable) and 5xx/network (transient). A 401 on token acquisition would be silently logged as generic 'lecture de la boîte échouée'. Consider explicit try/except httpx.HTTPStatusError with status_code introspection.

The new endpoint I added redacts creds via boolean flags only (safe). It does NOT expose token or secret in the response. Response includes tenant/client existence booleans, graph_user (already in .env by config), and up to 400 chars of Graph error body for troubleshooting — acceptable trade-off for an admin-only diag route.

rca of the issue: User activated mode=strict and provided 3 Azure AD creds. Backend was NOT restarted at that time, so runtime still had mode=off (logs at 01:11:46 confirm). After my restart, mode=strict is active and Graph client can authenticate + read the mailbox. BUT the code path _process_interac_deposit_emails requires a 4th env var INTERAC_TRUSTED_SENDER to gate 'which From address is a legitimate Interac notification'. It is empty, so the loop exits before hitting Graph. The pre-launch checklist item 1.1 is 80% complete — needs one more env var. Also, the code review shows this same gate should ideally be enforced at startup (like the 3 creds are) so admins see a single unified 'strict mode requires N vars — X missing' message instead of a runtime ERROR every 120s.
